[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new breakfast ideas and has been obsessed with overnight oats lately.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overnight oats are amazing, but there are many delicious vegan breakfast options available.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested breakfast ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Breakfast Bowls**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chia Seed Pudding Bowl: Mix chia seeds with plant-based milk, let it sit overnight, and top with fresh fruit, nuts, and granola.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Quinoa Breakfast Bowl: Cook quinoa and mix with roasted vegetables, nuts, and seeds. Add a drizzle of tahini sauce for creaminess.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Green Smoothie Bowl: Blend greens, fruit, and plant-based milk, then top with granola, nuts, and seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tofu and egg replacers include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Tofu Scramble**: Crumble tofu and cook with spices and veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Mung Bean Scramble**: Similar to tofu scramble, but with mung beans.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Chickpea Flour Omelette**: Whip up a chickpea flour mixture with water and spices, then cook like a traditional omelette.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested baked goods include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegan Muffins**: Made with plant-based milk, vegan chocolate chips, and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Cinnamon Rolls**: Made vegan with a flax egg and plant-based milk.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegan Waffles**: Waffle batter with plant-based milk, vegan chocolate chips, and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Avocado Toast**: Toast whole grain bread, mash avocado, and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegan Yogurt Parfait**: Layer plant-based yogurt with granola, fresh fruit, and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Green Juice**: Blend greens, fruits, and veggies for a nutrient-packed drink.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular vegan breakfast ingredients to experiment with include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Plant-based milks (almond, soy, oat, etc.), tofu, tempeh, chia seeds, flaxseeds, quinoa, amaranth, nut butters, vegan chocolate chips, fresh fruit, veggies, nuts, and seeds.
